Name: Goat Mod
Author: KramplessHeaven
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/HL54nhH.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿﻿
﻿﻿-> get completely new goats while still being able to buy the base game one!
-> thirteen unique breeds based on real life goats [seven from the previous version and a brand new one!]
-> male and female options for all goat breeds! The male goats obviously don't give you milk, but they give you more meat and produce manure! Both male and female fiber goats give you wool.
- [b]SAANEN GOAT [/b]is a perfect replacement for the base game goat. For the same price you can get a beautiful goat as white as lovely as a goat can be! Both males and females have four sprite variations visible when they get older!
-[b] TOGGENBURG GOAT[/b] is a pretty goat with white Swiss markings. Being one of the most productive diary goat breeds your Toggenburg Goats will produce milk daily! Four variations are available for males, females and kids!
- [b]VALAIS BLACKNECK GOAT [/b]is a majestic, long-haired goat with unique half black and half white coat! Not only is it beautiful, it also gives you milk! Available in three variations for all males, females and kids!
- [b]BOER GOAT[/b] is a white meat goat with brown head. It gives you little milk, but a lot of meat! It's also easy to maintain - it's relatively cheap and will thrive in just a basic Barn. Four variations are available for males, females and kids!
- [b]KALAHARI RED GOAT[/b] is a red meat goat from the Kalahari Desert. You'll need only 2,000 gold and a Barn to get yourself one! Four color variations are available for males, females and kids!
﻿- [b]NUBIAN GOAT[/b] is a bit pricier than the other ones, but it may be used as both diary and meat animal! It also has lovely long ears. Three color variations are available for males, females and kids!
- [b]LAMANCHA GOAT[/b] balances Nubian out with its very short ears! Some may say it looks really elegant, some may say it looks like an alien, but either way it's pretty distinctive! Three color variations are available for males, females and kids!
﻿- [b]ROYAL GOLDEN GUERNSEY [/b]is a rare breed of golden-coloured goat. It's a bit pricey and requires the Deluxe Barn, but gives you Large Goat Milk from the very beginning! Sixteen variations are available for females and four for males and kids! 
﻿- [b]NIGERIAN DWARF GOAT[/b] is really small and easy to maintain. It also makes a lovely companion animal! A special Dwarf Helmet hat is available for them in the config menu. Six color variations are available for all males, females and kids!
- [b]FAITING GOAT[/b] is both diary and meat animals a bit smaller than regular goats. Watch out, they may actually faint! Six color variations available for all males, females and kids!
﻿- [b]ANGORA GOAT[/b] is a beautiful white fiber goat that gives you wool every two days. Shaved and unshaved variations are available!
-[b] CASHMERE GOAT [/b]is a prestigious breed that gives you wool every day. Shaved and unshaved variations are available!
- [b]PYGORA GOATS[/b] is a cross between Angoras and Pygmys, they don't need much space and give you wool every two days. Shaved and unshaved variations are available!
﻿-> [b]KARPACKA GOATS[/b] are a beautiful breed of goat kept both for their milk and meat.
-> [b]KAZIMIERZOWSKA GOATS [/b]are known for being friendly and easy to maintain.
-> [b]SANDOMIERSKA GOATS [/b]produce regular Milk instead of Goat Milk. Four color variations are available for males, females and kids!

-> [b]HATS [/b]are now available for ALL your goats! They are based on in-game hats for the player and can be worn by all adult goats. Simply open the config menu and pick a hat for your variation of the goat, when the game is loaded all the hats you've chosen should be visible!
-> [b]GOAT MANURE[/b] is a new item produced by male goats everyday. Not only does it add a bit of realism, it works the same as the Basic Fertilizer and therefore makes male goats useful even without exchanging them for Mutton! If you want to use other manure mods, or don't want to use manure at all, you can download a "no manure" version of the mod from the Files page!

-> compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Digus' Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]﻿!
- when playing without the Animal Husbandry Mod, SMAPI will display a warning that [AHM] Goat Mod for Animal Husbandry [the mod adding the compatibility] could not be loaded. The Goat Mod itself works perfectly fine without it, so you may either ignore it or delete the [AHM] goat_mod folder, leaving only the [CP] goat_mod.
﻿- when slayed or exchanged for Mutton, the amount of meat you get depends on the breed, gender and friendship level with the goat!
- give treats to your animals! All our goats like the treats the basic game goat does, so it's easy to remember!
- all goats get impregnated; all goats can be chosen for the Animal Contest.
[center]
To install, extract the zip file and place the extracted folder in the mods folder of the game.
[steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods]
